statement: The Steam-running motion batch delivered reports but accel/gyro/quaternion fields remained identical through all six labelled actions, so it is not a usable motion reference. After Steam exited, SDL e0232c5 enabled accel/gyro through its normal API; raw accel, gyro and quaternion fields then changed during the repeated orientation/motion windows. The owner reported a yaw slip and accidental trigger/rear-button input. The evidence is qualitative raw sensor response, not calibrated angles, rates, forces or perfectly isolated axes.

applicability.revision: Owner-authorized retail direct-wired 28de:1302; physical revision not independently re-read
applicability.firmware: bcdDevice 0404 device-version marker; firmware attributes not re-read in each input-only reduction
applicability.scope: D9 bare metal, labelled physical sessions and known consumer operations only. No virtual Steam acceptance, universal firmware behavior, calibrated force or wireless result.
